composition_label: Knowledge-base answers (AI customer support) -> Semantic search (Smart product search)

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.request: query: nonblank searchable string; top_k: integer 1..100 default 5; faq_min_score: finite 0..1 default 0.6; search_min_score: finite 0..1 default 0.01
input.knowledge_base: list of {id, question, answer, keywords: string[], product_ids: string[]}
input.products: list of {id, title, description, tags: string[]}

shared_schema.error: schema_version=1, status=error, error=message; CLI exit code 2
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate() boundary checks input, FAQ grounding and product references, then semantic output. Unknown input fields, duplicate IDs or JSON keys, nonfinite values and invalid embedding shapes are rejected.
shared_schema.faq_handoff: query preserved exactly, grounded_terms derived only from cited FAQ keywords, product_ids restricted to cited FAQ references

cross_stage_handoffs.validation: FAQ output is checked before indexing or invoking an injected embedder. Search query expansion and link flags are checked against that validated output.
cross_stage_handoffs.abstention: No answer, citations, grounded terms or product links; original query still drives product search.

behavior.faq: Retrieve by normalized query-token coverage of FAQ question and keywords; require positive evidence and configured threshold; deterministic ID tie-break. Grounded answer is the cited answer verbatim, not generated text. Confidence is lexical coverage, not calibrated probability.
behavior.index: In-memory inverted product index with maximum per-token field weight: title=3, tags=2, description=1.
behavior.semantic: Deterministic English token normalization with a small explicit alias dictionary; enrich query with cited FAQ keywords. Lexical relevance is weighted token coverage normalized by 3 times expanded-query size.
behavior.ranking: Without embedding: 0.9 lexical + 0.1 FAQ link. With embedding: 0.6 lexical + 0.3 nonnegative cosine + 0.1 FAQ link. Round scores to eight decimals, filter positive scores at configured threshold, sort descending then product ID, truncate top_k.
behavior.embedding_interface: Optional run_pipeline(payload, embedder=callable). Callable receives normalized enriched query followed by catalog descriptions and returns one finite, nonzero, equal-dimensional numeric vector per text. Synthetic fixtures only; no live provider.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object to stdout. Success exit 0; file, decoding, schema and JSON errors exit 2.

included: Deterministic ranking and injected embedding fixture tests
excluded: Live LLMs, providers or network access
General natural-language entailment, negation or contradiction detection
Learned semantic embeddings unless supplied by caller

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status=ok
